title: [Main]-Payment Orders posted in Foreign Currency (USD) do not populate Source Currency Code and Source Currency Amount in G/L Entries in the Spanish version.
summary: Payment orders and bill groups posted in foreign currency now correctly populate the source currency code and amount fields in general ledger entries for the Spanish localization.
key_points: G/L entries from posted payment orders now include the source currency code
G/L entries from posted payment orders now include the source currency amount
Bill groups posted in foreign currency receive the same fix
Includes test coverage for the fix
